beats.text: The city library now stays open until *midnight*. The change starts *Monday*.
Visits rose *40%|forty_percent* last year, to about one hundred sixty-eight thousand.
The director said: “We want the building used, not admired.”

overlay.quote: We want the building used, not admired.
overlay.name: Library director
overlay.sourceText: Speaking on Tuesday, the director said: "We want the building used, not admired." Staffing for the late shift is funded until next year.

beats.text: Late shifts are funded until *next year*. <short pause> What do you think?
